usage: Gui6 is an adjective used to describe the feeling of being physically or mentally tired.
It can be used in simple present tense to express current tiredness, e.g. 'I am tired'.
Gui6 can be combined with pronouns or nouns to indicate who is tired, like 'he is tired'.
It can also appear in past tense contexts when talking about tiredness after activities, e.g. 'I was tired after work'.
Gui6 is commonly used in daily conversations to quickly express low energy or fatigue.
